# Air Quality Advisor v0.2.3 — Repeating actionable announcements

This release adds optional **time-based reminders** when a window recommendation remains valid.

### What's new
- **Repeat announcements (minutes)** in **Configure → Announcements**, default **10 minutes**.
- Enter **0** to **never repeat**. Whole-number intervals from 0–1440 minutes are supported.
- Reminders are per room. They only continue while the same window action and underlying air-quality/weather reason persist.
- Sensor values changing *within the same unsafe range* do not restart the reminder. A different cause starts a fresh interval. The window changing state or the recommendation clearing cancels reminders.
- First-time opening advice still waits 90 seconds; urgent window-closing advice is immediate. Timed repeats bypass the 15-minute new-open cooldown.
- The regular Announcement Hub/AI, native notify/TTS and persistent notification paths are reused. No new entities or window actuators are added.
- UI labels and explanations are available across all 38 languages; no configuration migration is necessary.

### GitHub Actions are now manual-only
**Pushing to `main` no longer runs checks or publishes a release.** Once all changes are pushed, manually start **Actions → Validate and release (on demand) → Run workflow**. A default run validates only. Enable **Publish release** to publish `v0.2.3` after all gates pass.

### Compatibility
Existing thresholds, rooms, sensor exclusions, dashboard and AI/Announcement Hub settings remain unchanged. Previous integrations without a saved interval default to 10 minutes. A timer is active only when automatic notification and/or TTS is enabled.

**Important:** This release is staged for manual validation; it is not a published GitHub/HACS release until that workflow succeeds with the explicit Publish release input.
